annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes downloading a cryptocurrency trading bot while presenting daily returns of 2-10% in falling markets and over 30% in growing markets. It instructs viewers to start the bot, commit BNB, and attempt to profit by following another wallet's trades. The speaker reports that one demonstrated position closed negatively, so the return figures remain promotional claims rather than established results.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: A trading bot is linked to activation, wallet configuration, capital participation and trading-profit claims. The source describes starting the application after entering a wallet address, investing BNB, and profiting from wallet-following trades. The source explicitly presents front-running a donor wallet's sale as a market-manipulation mechanism intended to obtain profit. The inputs do not establish that the mechanism successfully worked.
